# rust/dead-code: what a failure looks like

Each case is one change on the pack's fixture repo. `gatekeeper selftest` runs every case and fails unless the gate fails on it printing the line shown, so these examples cannot go stale.

## exported-file

Writes `.gatekeeper/config.toml`:

```
packs = ["rust"]
integration = "main"
pin = "checkout"

[rust.exported]
"crates/a/src/lib.rs" = "called from a host program outside the workspace"
```

Writes `Cargo.lock`:

```
# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
version = 4

[[package]]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
```

Writes `Cargo.toml`:

```
[workspace]
members = ["crates/*"]
resolver = "2"
```

Writes `crates/a/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
```

Writes `crates/a/src/lib.rs`:

```
#[must_use]
pub fn entry() -> u8 {
    1
}
```

The gate passes.

## ignored-dependency

Writes `Cargo.lock`:

```
# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
version = 4

[[package]]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
dependencies = [
 "b",
]

[[package]]
name = "b"
version = "0.1.0"
```

Writes `Cargo.toml`:

```
[workspace]
members = ["crates/*"]
resolver = "2"
```

Writes `crates/a/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
b = { path = "../b" }

[package.metadata.cargo-machete]
ignored = ["b"]
```

Writes `crates/a/src/main.rs`:

```
fn main() {}
```

Writes `crates/b/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "b"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
```

Writes `crates/b/src/lib.rs`:

```

```

The gate fails and its log prints `crates/a/Cargo.toml: ignored for cargo-machete: b`.

Fix: write pub(crate), and the compiler then says whether it is dead; delete an unused dependency or its machete ignore; a crate others build against goes under [rust.exported] with its reason; once one is fixed, shrink the list: ./.gatekeeper/run baseline rust/dead-code. Rerun: `./.gatekeeper/run check --gate rust/dead-code`

```

version = 4

[[package]]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"

 "a",
]
```

```

members = ["crates/*"]
resolver = "2"
```

Writes `crates/a/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
```

Writes `crates/a/src/lib.rs`:

```
#[must_use]
pub fn api() -> u8 {
    1
}
```

Writes `crates/b/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "b"
version = "0.1.0"

## pub-in-a-binary

Writes `Cargo.lock`:

```
# This file is automatically @generated by Cargo.
# It is not intended for manual editing.
version = 4

[[package]]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"

Writes `Cargo.toml`:

```

members = ["crates/*"]
resolver = "2"
```

Writes `crates/a/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "a"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
```

Writes `crates/a/src/main.rs`:

```
fn main() {
    std::process::exit(code());
}

#[must_use]
pub fn code() -> i32 {
    0
}
```

The gate fails and its log prints `crates/a/src/main.rs: pub fn code: no other crate names it`.

Fix: write pub(crate), and the compiler then says whether it is dead; delete an unused dependency or its machete ignore; a crate others build against goes under [rust.exported] with its reason; once one is fixed, shrink the list: ./.gatekeeper/run baseline rust/dead-code. Rerun: `./.gatekeeper/run check --gate rust/dead-code`

Writes `crates/a/src/lib.rs`:

```
pub struct Inner(pub u8);

pub struct Outer {
    pub inner: Inner,
}

#[must_use]
pub fn outer() -> Outer {
    Outer { inner: Inner(1) }
}
```

Writes `crates/b/Cargo.toml`:

```
[package]
name = "b"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

[dependencies]
a = { path = "../a" }
```

Writes `crates/b/src/main.rs`:

```
fn main() {
    std::process::exit(i32::from(a::outer().inner.0));
}
```

The gate passes.
